newsitem.title: USA: Braun's names new president, new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Braun's names new president, new CFO.

text.p: Braun's Fashions Corp said Wednesday it had named William Prange as president and chief merchandising officer.
The company also said it had named Herbert Froemming as vice chairman and chief administrative and financial officer.
Nicholas Cook remains chairman and chief executive, it said.
Prange was formerly senior vice president and general merchandising manager of the women's clothing retailer.
Froemming was formerly president and chief operating officer and was CFO from January 1989 to May 1994, Braun's said.
In reassuming the title of CFO, Froemming succeeds Stephen Clark, who left the company following its recent emergence from Chapter 11 reorganization proceedings, it said.
Braun's operates 170 stores in 20 states, mainly in the Upper Midwest.
